I drew the diagram and opened it in your default image viewer. The PNG is at `/tmp/diag/deps.png`. I also viewed it myself, and it renders correctly.

The four modules under `src/` depend on each other like this:

- `app.py` imports `report`.
- `report.py` imports `charts` and `db`.
- `charts.py` imports `db`.
- `db.py` imports nothing from `src/`, only the standard library (`csv` and `pathlib`).

The dependencies run in one direction, with no cycles. `db` is the base layer, and `app` is the entry point at the top.

I drew it with matplotlib because Graphviz and Mermaid aren't installed here. The PNG is in `/tmp`, not in the repo, so copy it somewhere permanent if you want to keep it.
